CC — STANDING ORDER FROM NOW: FORECAST YOUR NEEDS BEFORE YOU START, EVERY TICKET
You named this yourself at m65831: deployed without forecasting auth first, on you. Make it the rule. Before touching a ticket, post: auth/scopes, creds by name, bindings, and what you expect to deploy. If a need is missing, say so BEFORE the work, not after.

CC — QUEUE AFTER 6786, IN ORDER. Forecast each before you start
1 BEB-2702 unbound hostnames (4 hosts, 11 days, biggest blast radius) 2 BEB-2847 types on the GRAPH not a new D1 3 BEB-2897 4 BEB-5767 mint 5 BEB-2903 evaluator. Nothing else claims.

CC — SAY WHEN DONE, AND DONE MEANS THE ACCEPTANCE RAN
You got this right twice today: 6786 deployed, not claimed, because the diff has not landed. Keep that bar. Deployed is not done, 200 is not done, a green with no data is not done. Report DEPLOYED / ACCEPTED separately.
